qualification_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(FilesPaneSanitizers LANGUAGES CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SOURCE}" SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${FIXTURES}" FIXTURES)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
find_package(ckvision 1.4.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
if(MSVC)
 add_compile_options(/fsanitize=address)
 add_link_options(/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)
else()
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING ON)
enable_testing()
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_library(ck_vision_shell STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/suite_shell.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
cktools_strict(ck_vision_shell)
add_library(ck_vision_cktest_main STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/tests/support")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
target_compile_definitions(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}")
cktools_strict(ck_vision_cktest_main)
add_library(ck_options STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/common/options/options.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_options PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_options PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
add_library(ck_vision_keymap STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/keymap.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/suite_keymap_catalog.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC ckvision::cvision ck_options)
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" ui)

add_executable(ck_files_directory_row_tests "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_indexed_pane.cpp" "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_index_file_native.cpp")
target_link_libraries(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE ck_files_platform ck_vision_cktest_main)
target_compile_definitions(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT}")
cktools_strict(ck_files_directory_row_tests)
add_test(NAME directory_row_core COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_indexed_pane.cpp)
add_test(NAME directory_row_native COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_index_file_native.cpp)
set_tests_properties(directory_row_core directory_row_native PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 180)

timing_investigation.normal: Final Mac incremental build 3.784 s for 2 C++ actions plus archive/executable links, compared with the preceding 9.415 s build for 12 C++ actions plus links. Linux/Windows builds took 19.551/35.799 s versus the preceding pane-controls 41.999/12.822 s. The newly changed shared indexed-pane/lookup headers trigger dependent recompilation; actual normal compile counts and logs are retained. Per-input object/executable ordering and final hashes establish Mac freshness; matching remote input manifests and full instrumented rebuilds establish the qualified source sets.
timing_investigation.sdk: Fresh SDK build durations: Mac 84.632 s versus recent 109.739 s, Linux 156.291 s versus 224.321 s. Windows configure/build/install together 76.029 s versus 94.864 s. Every expected SDK C++ action (124/124/128), instrumentation flags, source/install hashes and successful archives are verified. No compiler-cache launchers occur in the commands. Shared Mac/Lima build intervals overlap, so load is a plausible contributor to variable elapsed times; no sole timing cause is claimed.
timing_investigation.product: Expanded clean harness has 73 product units; the previous harness had 71. Build durations are 84.064/148.481/67.861 s on Mac/Linux/Windows versus previous 118.938/81.167/84.480 s. Two additional large test translation units broaden coverage. There was no directly comparable prior 73-unit harness baseline. All 73 actual compile actions, final hashes and instrumentation are checked, with successful links for both test executables; elapsed time is not used as freshness proof.
timing_investigation.tests: Expanded sanitizer durations are 79.130/48.732/157.003 s versus prior UI/service-only 9.490/2.476/12.716 s. Exact test sets now include indexed-pane cases and the native 100000-row scan, external sort, lookup and filter cases. Native suites take 71.11/43.63/139.16 s, with external sort markers 36.600/27.055/88.884 s. Qualified markers, all platform-specific cases and all bounds pass; no native test is skipped or weakened to reduce duration. These runs establish the expanded-harness baseline.

review.binding: One explicit visible scoped row, independent of focus/marks; bounded disk rank lookup and single native record. Held-parent relative no-follow open only. Fresh metadata-only child stays alive through cursor creation, live scope/identity/kind checks, retained-child reinspection and parent reinspection. No display parsing, absolute path reopen, cwd change or directory enumeration in the binding method.
review.identity_limit: Cached discovery IDs are observations. Matching IDs are only a contradiction check and cannot exclude ID reuse before the fresh binding or prove continuity from discovery. Returned cursor pins the newly bound live directory; it grants no mutation, snapshot, mount confinement or provider permission.
review.failure: Stale/foreign/excluded/pending/unqualified/contradictory targets refuse. Native errors retain state/domain/code/operation and win over concurrent cancellation. Supersession/cancellation and failures release private owners without a partial cursor. Bounded name/wire/metadata diagnostics refuse explicitly. Failed/corrupt index storage revokes issued stamps; exceptions unwind owners.
review.tests: Nine new core cases plus one native case. All 83 Files suites pass 820/823/819 cases on macOS/Linux/Windows plus keymap. Matched sanitizer builds execute 130/128/127 cases on macOS/Linux/Windows: 60 UI/service, 53 indexed-pane and 17/15/14 platform-specific native-index cases, with all 73 product units and installed instrumented pinned ckVision 1.4.0 SDK units 124/124/128 verified.
review.excluded: The first build failed because IndexedPane lacked private lookup-failure access; explicit internal friendship fixes the owning state-management boundary. Initial budget fixture had no diagnostic text to exhaust its diagnostic budget; corrected. Initial UTF-16 fixture used Linux storage-model validation and aborted during setup; corrected to WindowsHandleAttributes. Those failed runs do not qualify the final source.
review.scope: Worker-domain prerequisite only. Service submission/acknowledgment, child address/history presentation, UI commands, completion, qualified refresh, properties/preview, history/bookmarks and production executable/actual terminal acceptance remain WP-02 work. No source filesystem mutation enabled. No GUI application launched. New method is serialized worker-only and introduces no threading protocol changes; no new TSan claim.
